adjudication.rationale: `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a raw `fetch` `Response` object when sync mode is enabled (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`). In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the result is typed/used as `HubspotToken` (`const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)`). Since a `Response` won’t have HubSpot token fields like `access_token`/`accessToken` or `expires_in`/`expiresIn`, any subsequent logic computing expiry from `hubspotRefreshToken.expiresIn` (or setting the access token from it) will get `undefined`, leading to `NaN` expiry and missing access token in sync mode. This mismatch is directly introduced by the diff because HubSpot does not parse the sync endpoint response into a token object (unlike other integrations that added `parseRefreshTokenResponse`).
